reproducibility.contract: same absolute source/SDK paths and toolchain; clean caches, output names, cwd and worker counts vary

workspace.scope: Edit pairs include two diagnostic/navigation barriers; RSS is process RSS, not retained heap size

scaling.allocation_scope: compiler and generated parser only; requested bytes include realloc requests
scaling.rss_scope: fresh helper maximum RSS; includes shared libraries

limits: All conformance fixtures cover rule families, not all language rules.
SDK reference inventory is textual, not behavioral coverage.
Performance thresholds and bounded soak are local evidence only.
Native cross-links do not demonstrate execution.
CI YAML parsed locally; no remote run was performed.
pending: LLVM 18 release baseline and both provider CI environments

GPU/device coverage, sustained user experience and independent security review for stronger assurances
